name: sphere
description: Work with SPHERE from Claude Code: organizations, members, permissions, pricings, collections, notifications and profile. Every change is proposed as a plan you confirm in SPHERE.

api_key.title: SPHERE API key
api_key.description: Create one in SPHERE > API keys. Use a dedicated key with the narrowest scopes and an expiry date. It is stored in your system's secure credential store.

server_url.title: SPHERE URL
server_url.description: Address of the SPHERE instance, without a trailing slash. Change it only for a self-hosted or local SPHERE, such as http://localhost:5173.
